verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is an agentic payments and credential platform, so pushed lifecycle events are a fair question to ask of it. However, the pack documents no webhook or event subscription for orders being created, updated, fulfilled or canceled. The closest items are a generic claim to "confirm payment outcomes and trigger post-purchase actions in real-time" and a request-driven purchase-intent cancel API. Neither is a pushed order-lifecycle event feed.
